integrity.mathematical_scope: Labelled simple complete bipartite K_{2,n}, integer charges, synchronous neighbor-difference diffusion, initially periodic states modulo translation
integrity.reproducibility: Two standalone implementations: exact multinomial formula for n=1..10, independent exhaustive vertex dynamics on all 9,602,861 normalized states for n=1..5
integrity.unproved_limits: No conjectural extrapolation from finite enumeration; asymptotics, transient basins and external certification not claimed.

scientific_limitations: Counts initially periodic charge configurations modulo common integer translation; does not enumerate transient basins or fixed-mass slices.
The genuinely new parameter range of the two-hub census is n>=3; the n=2 four-cycle specialization is known.
The formula is a finite multinomial sum rather than a compact asymptotic expansion.
Complete historical priority cannot be established for unindexed literature; no independent audit has occurred.
title: Exact two-cycle counts and sharp hub-gap spectrum for integer diffusion on \(K_{2,n}\)
